Metadata.Goal: 从旧源码 owner 退休已迁出的 Domain Suite 与 demo surface。
Metadata.Description: Delete retired Domain packages and composition while preserving source-language and data capabilities.

TaskSpace.name: retire-extracted-domain-suite-from-legacy-source
TaskSpace.Description: Package retirement, Web narrowing, owner-doc cleanup, and retained-capability proof.

TaskGroup.name: Retire Domain Packages
TaskGroup.Description: Delete the extracted package owners and root graph edges.

Task.name: Remove four Domain packages
Task.Description: Delete protocol/runtime/server/context packages plus owned tests/fixtures and update root build/references/lock.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: all four retired package directories and root graph entries are absent
remaining manifests and imports contain no retired package identity or dependency edge

TaskGroup.name: Narrow Web Product
TaskGroup.Description: Remove Domain composition while retaining Kon product behavior.

Task.name: Make server and IDE Kon-only
Task.Description: Remove Domain routes/registrations/page/client/components/tests/E2E and preserve execute-kon/Kon IDE/demos.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: web-server exposes execute-kon but no Domain catalog or Domain execute routes
web-ide exposes only Kon routes/views and all Kon E2E behavior remains green

TaskGroup.name: Clean Current Ownership
TaskGroup.Description: Remove current Domain owner knowledge and establish source-only authority.

Task.name: Retire current Domain documentation
Task.Description: Delete current Domain behavior/decision/evidence owner claims while retaining immutable history and source/data truth.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: current behavior and decisions no longer claim extracted Domain ownership
source-only-scope behavior positively records retained and retired boundaries

TaskGroup.name: Verify Remaining Scope
TaskGroup.Description: Prove no residue and no retained capability regression.

Task.name: Run full regression and residue matrix
Task.Description: Run all tests/build/typechecks/Kon smoke/E2E and exact source/dist/current-doc scans.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: full retained workspace test build typecheck server smoke and Kon E2E pass
source/dist/current authority have zero retired Domain package route context and UI owner residue
